tweet.text:
ESP32 Modbus industrial IoT gateway with support for RTU, TCP/IP, and MQTT.
https://www.cnx-software.com/2025/08/19/esp32-modbus-gateway-handles-rtu-tcp-ip-and-mqtt-for-industrial-iot/

It features 2.4 GHz WiFI, Ethernet, and RS485 communication interfaces, and targets farms, factories, and electrical cabinets where reliable communication, remote monitoring, and control are required.

The company provides Arduino code samples for Modbus RTU/TCP (master and slave), MQTT, FOTA updates, watchdog, deep sleep, auto Wi-Fi/Ethernet switching, and more.
